title.narrative: Fair Africa - Fostering Accountability, Integrity and Reform: Anti-Corruptionand Financial Integrity for Domestic Resource Mobilisation andDevelopment in Africa (FAIR Africa)

description.narrative: The project pursues two primary outcomes, seeking (1) anti-corruption and financial integrity measures in domestic frameworks governing resource mobilisation and allocation at the national level and (2) priority measures to support African countries in reducing resource leakages and illicit financial flows at the multilateral level, with the ultimate goal of improving the ability of African countries to raise domestic resources and channel public funds toward development outcomes. Value of the contract - 1,808,979 Euros
